children: Index provider MSCI has added four Indian companies to its flagship Global Standard index and increased weights of eleven other stocks as part of its November index review, effectively also raising India's weight in its emerging market index.
are the additions to the flagship index. The index provider also removed agrochemicals maker PI Industries
"India's weight in the MSCI EM Index is set to increase from 11.5% to 11.7%, translating into estimated incremental
passive inflows of around $2 billion," analysts at Nuvama Wealth Management said in a note.
